notes.title: Update 0.03
notes.content:
Friends, welcome our first major update since the day the game became available!ːsteamhappyː

https://i.imgur.com/aUWFRmW.png

List of work done:
[olist]
 Animation. We fixed the bugs due to which several objects appeared at the same time or disappeared altogether.

 Sound. Corrected the bugs due to which there were overlaying sounds and some other inconsistencies. Added sounds to the fair.

 Inventory. Fixed bugs due to which it was possible to change the active item during the action.

 4th act. Particular attention was paid to the broken parallax in the second half of Act 4, when Mikola wakes up and a dialogue with the Wife begins.

 Cut scenes. They also got a little attention.

 In addition to all of the above, we worked hard to fix a number of other minor and major errors that disrupted the gameplay and spoiled the impression of the game.
[/olist]
Enjoy the game!ːsteamhappyː

P.S. The build was tested by regular testers, everything went perfectly, we hope that everything will go smoothly for you as well and you will be satisfied with the game.

notes.title: Steam Gift Card Giveaway from Highly Likely Developers
notes.content:
Hello dear friends!

To celebrate the upcoming release of the game, we decided to run a giveaway of Steam digital gift cards with a total cost of more than $3000.

We will give away 105* gift cards!


 $100 – 3 cards.
$50 - 10 cards.
$25 - 37 cards.


But there’s more! During the live stream, we will give away additional five $100 gift cards.

And that's not all! In addition to the gift cards, we will also give away the game keys.

Giveaway rules:[olist]
 Share this post with your friends no later than January 16!
To do this, click "Share" under this post, then "Share directly to my status" and then "Post". This news will appear in your Steam profile activity feed.

 Add the game to your wish list.

 Write a funny phrase about our game using the name of the game “Highly Likely” in the comments to this post to confirm your participation.[/olist]
The draw will take place on January 17 during a live stream. The time of the stream and the link will be announced additionally. Follow the news!

Winners will be selected randomly using the service https://www.random.org/

The cards of the lower value will be given away first, the $100 cards last!

IMPORTANT! If the winner does not meet one or more of the 3 above requirements, they will automatically drop out of the participants and another winner will be chosen.
Prizes will be awarded within 3 days in accordance with the rules for transferring Steam gift cards.

Dear friends, make sure that your steam profile in not private in order to receive your prize!

We wish you luck and good mood!ːsteamhappyː

P.S. We will be very grateful if you share this news with your friends on Facebook or Twitter or Reddit. All you have to do is click “Share” under this post, then “Share on Facebook”, “Share on Twitter”, “Share on Reddit”.

*We run 2 giveaways: One for Russian-speaking players, and another for players from all countries except Russia and CIS. The total number of cards in both giveaways is 105.
